summary: My toddler has been on a seaweed kick lately, so I’ve been wrapping just about everything in nori… and she eats it every single time! This easy rice roll is healthy, filling, and perfect for lunch or dinner.
caption: My toddler has been on a seaweed kick lately, so I’ve been wrapping just about everything in nori… and she eats it every single time! 😂🥑🍙 This easy rice roll is healthy, filling, and perfect for lunch or dinner. ✨ You’ll need: • Steamed sticky rice • Cooked chicken • ½ avocado • 1 tbsp cottage cheese • Dash of garlic powder • 1 sushi nori sheet • Light drizzle of sesame oil This recipe makes 2 toddler meals! I refrigerate the leftover rice and roll it fresh the next day so the nori stays nice and crisp instead of getting soggy. Save this recipe for your next meal idea and let me know if your toddler is on a seaweed kick too! ❤️ Like & follow @busymamaeasybites for more toddler recipes, parent-friendly products, and toddler destinations! #easyrecipe #toddlermeals #toddlersnacks #toddlerlunch #toddlerdinner
